independent_derivation.branch_partition: For each neighbor w of support u other than the tagged leaf v, let C_w be the w-side after cutting uw. In T-v, sets omitting u contribute product I(C_w); sets containing u contribute z times product I(C_w-w). This is exactly P_{u,v}.
independent_derivation.deletion_difference: In T-{u,v}, the remaining C_w components are unrestricted, giving product J_w. In T-N[u], each w is removed and the remainder of each branch contributes I(C_w-w), giving product A_w. Their difference is Q_{u,v}.
independent_derivation.coefficient_indices: Delta_p(T-v) is [z^(p+1)]P-[z^p]P. For Q=I(T-{u,v})-I(T-N[u]), its coefficient at p minus its coefficient at p-1 is precisely Delta_(p-1)(T-{u,v})-Delta_(p-1)(T-N[u]).
independent_derivation.tag_multiplicity: For any two original leaves v,v' adjacent to the same u, their branch lists differ only by exchanging identical singleton branches. Each singleton has J=1+z and A=1. Thus P and Q, and hence selector and summand, are equal; multiplying once by m_u retains all distinct tagged leaves.
independent_derivation.root_recurrence: For a rooted subtree, root-excluded sets independently choose any child-subtree independent set, giving E=product(E_c+O_c); root-included sets require every child root excluded, giving O=z product E_c.
independent_derivation.truncation_and_guards: Products in nonnegative powers of z preserve coefficients through degree p+1 under truncation modulo z^(p+2). This covers the selector through degree p+1 and Q through degree p. The guard x+2<=p is equivalent to some Delta_j<0 for 0<=j<=p-2, decided from coefficients through p-1. The strict lower-region guard uses separately computed alpha(T).

sanity_instance.tree: Star with center u and m>=1 original leaves.
sanity_instance.aggregate_encoding: All m leaf tags have the same selector and same coefficient difference, so the formula gives m times that tagged contribution, including zero when the tag is not favorable.

scope_check: These identities are unconditional algebra for finite ordinary trees and fixed p>=2. They do not establish S(T,p)<=0, a bounded census, or a context-closed compressed transfer state.
method_limit: Independent symbolic derivation and a star sanity instance; no source algorithm replay or computational census was performed.
